channel.title: CiteSprint · AI visibility reviews
channel.description: Dated practice reviews of how ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Grok recommend small developer tools. Not customer case studies.

item.title: AI knows Cronhooks exists — but rarely recommends it
item.description: Practice review (Oct 9, 2026 IST): on 3 generic cron/webhook prompts, ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity named Cronhooks in 0 of 9 answers; all 4 assistants described it when asked by name. Not a customer; no affiliation.

item.title: How AI engines evaluate a developer tool — Checkly baseline
item.description: Practice review (Sep 29 + Oct 2–3, 2026 IST): Checkly was often named early on API, synthetics and as-code prompts, but is easy to miss on classic "uptime monitoring" wording. Not a customer case study.
